card.name: MAO inhibitor drug label text
card.fires_on: Mostly the middle of the name Phenelzine (the 'el' piece) and nearby words in labels for MAO inhibitors such as phenelzine, tranylcypromine and rasagiline. It also fires on scattered digits and linking words in these labels.

modes.label: Inside Phenelzine
modes.description: The 'el' piece in the middle of Phenelzine Sulfate Tablets, or the word sulfate right after it.

modes.description: Linking words, digits or spaces within MAOI label text, such as 'such' before as alcohol or a digit in a number.

card.writes: It promotes odd word pieces and suppresses words starting with 'prom', so it adds no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up in labels for older antidepressant MAO inhibitors, especially inside the name phenelzine.
